episode_id: Fix the stale config entry the app is warning about, without losing any setting. Rename the old key in the project's settings and keep its value./seed-8-config_renamed-212

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (config_renamed seed 1 resolves to 'drop_old', which accepts ['drop_old'], but the program implements 'rename'); firing where a sibling resolution is correct is the mismatch this gate exists to refuse

refused_program.body:
set -u
cd -- "{work_dir}"
map=$(git ls-files -z | tr '\0' '\n' | while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  head -n 3 -- "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE '^[[:space:]]*#.*renam' || continue
  grep -IqE '^[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+[[:space:]]*$' -- "$f" && printf '%s\n' "$f"
done | head -n 1)
if [ -z "$map" ]; then
  echo "no rename map found" >&2
  exit 1
fi
mapdir=$(dirname -- "$map")
script=""
while IFS= read -r line; do
  case "$line" in
    ''|\#*) continue ;;
  esac
  case "$line" in
    *=*) ;;
    *) continue ;;
  esac
  old=${line%%=*}
  new=${line#*=}
  old=$(printf '%s' "$old" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  new=$(printf '%s' "$new" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$old" ] || [ -z "$new" ]; then
    continue
  fi
  e_old=$(printf '%s' "$old" | sed 's/[][\\.*^$]/\\&/g')
  e_new=$(printf '%s' "$new" | sed 's/[\/&]/\\&/g')
  script="${script}s/^\([[:space:]]*\)${e_old}\([[:space:]]*\)=/\1${e_new}\2=/"$'\n'
done < "$map"
if [ -z "$script" ]; then
  echo "rename map declares no keys" >&2
  exit 1
fi
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  if [ "$f" = "$map" ]; then
    continue
  fi
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  grep -IqE '^[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+[[:space:]]*=' -- "$f" || continue
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  if sed -e "$script" -- "$f" > "$tmp"; then
    cat -- "$tmp" > "$f"
  fi
  rm -f "$tmp"
done < <(git ls-files -z -- "$mapdir" | tr '\0' '\n')
refused_program.intent: Rename a stale settings key to the name the project's own rename map declares for it, preserving its value and leaving every other setting untouched.

postconditions.description: No tracked settings file other than the rename map still assigns an old key name, so the stale entry is really gone.
postconditions.name: no_stale_key_left
postconditions.probe:
cd -- "{work_dir}"
map=$(git ls-files -z | tr '\0' '\n' | while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  head -n 3 -- "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE '^[[:space:]]*#.*renam' || continue
  grep -IqE '^[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+[[:space:]]*$' -- "$f" && printf '%s\n' "$f"
done | head -n 1)
[ -n "$map" ] || exit 1
mapdir=$(dirname -- "$map")
olds=$(grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*#' -- "$map" | sed -nE 's/^[[:space:]]*([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+[[:space:]]*$/\1/p')
for old in $olds; do
  git ls-files -z -- "$mapdir" | tr '\0' '\n' | while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
    if [ "$f" = "$map" ]; then continue; fi
    grep -qE "^[[:space:]]*${old}[[:space:]]*=" -- "$f" && printf '%s\n' "$f"
  done
done | grep -q . && exit 1
exit 0

postconditions.description: Each file that now assigns a new key name carries exactly the value that HEAD's version of that file assigned to the corresponding old key name.

postconditions.probe:

done | head -n 1)
[ -n "$map" ] || exit 1
mapdir=$(dirname -- "$map")
count=0
while IFS= read -r line; do
  case "$line" in
    ''|\#*) continue ;;
  esac
  case "$line" in
    *=*) ;;
    *) continue ;;
  esac
  old=${line%%=*}
  new=${line#*=}
  old=$(printf '%s' "$old" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  new=$(printf '%s' "$new" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$old" ] || [ -z "$new" ]; then
    continue
  fi
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
    if [ "$f" = "$map" ]; then continue; fi
    now=$(grep -E "^[[:space:]]*${new}[[:space:]]*=" -- "$f" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | sed -E 's/^[^=]*=[[:space:]]*//')
    [ -n "$now" ] || continue
    git cat-file -e "HEAD:${f}" 2>/dev/null || continue
    was=$(git show "HEAD:${f}" 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^[[:space:]]*${old}[[:space:]]*=" | head -n 1 | sed -E 's/^[^=]*=[[:space:]]*//')

    [ "$now" = "$was" ] || exit 1
    count=$((count + 1))

done < "$map"
